nodes.description: EIP-1967 implementation storage slot 0x360894a13ba1a3210667c828492db98dca3e2076cc3735a920a3ca505d382bbc used by both Proxy and EIP173Proxy assembly.
EIP-1967 owner/admin storage slot 0xb53127684a568b3173ae13b9f8a6016e243e63b6e8ee1178d6a717850b5d6103 holding the proxy owner address.
EIP173Proxy constructor(address implementationAddress, bytes data, address ownerAddress) payable: sets implementation and owner at deployment.
EIP173Proxy.owner() external view returns the admin address from storage.
EIP173Proxy.supportsInterface(bytes4 id): ERC-165 check that may delegate to the implementation via try/catch.
EIP173Proxy.transferOwnership(address newOwner) external onlyOwner: transfers proxy ownership.
EIP173Proxy.changeImplementation(address newImplementation, bytes calldata data) external payable onlyOwner: upgrades the implementation.
onlyOwner modifier: require(msg.sender == _owner(), "NOT_AUTHORIZED") access-control gate.
EIP173Proxy._owner() internal view: reads the owner address from the EIP-1967 admin slot via assembly sload.
EIP173Proxy._setOwner(address newOwner) internal: writes the admin slot with sstore and emits OwnershipTransferred.
Proxy.receive() external payable virtual: explicitly reverts with ETHER_REJECTED.
Proxy.fallback() external payable: forwards execution to _fallback().
Proxy._fallback() internal: assembly delegatecall to the stored implementation with raw calldata and returned returndata.
Proxy._setImplementation(address newImplementation, bytes memory data) internal: writes the implementation slot and optionally delegatecalls initialization data.
msg.sender, caller address compared against the stored owner inside the onlyOwner modifier.
delegatecall(gas(), implementationAddress, 0x0, calldatasize(), 0, 0) inside _fallback: arbitrary code execution in proxy context with untrusted calldata.
newImplementation.delegatecall(data) inside _setImplementation: owner-supplied delegatecall executed during upgrade.
assembly sstore of the admin slot in _setOwner: unchecked raw storage write of ownership.
assembly sstore of the implementation slot in _setImplementation: unchecked raw storage write of the implementation address.
